scope:
Analytic target packets for a flat-ramp prefix plus a sine-integral bridge.

The main prefix parameters are exact binary rationals; Tu/Td are recomputed
as exact rational expressions. The angular clamped cubic spline is solved
over Fraction, not rounded PPoly coefficients. The bridge uses frozen
binary L,pt,ps, but its sine integral is certified by Taylor bounds. This
does NOT certify that those bridge constants are the exact matching root.
The endpoint radius/derivative discrepancies are reported separately.

bridge_constants.root_status: Frozen numeric constants only; exact matching root not certified.

analytic_definition: Flat-ramp a(s): exact rational formulas in the saved binary main parameters; Tu,Td recomputed by Fraction. The clamped angular spline is solved exactly over Fraction and multiplied by the prescribed quintic cutoff. The bridge has frozen binary L,pt,ps but uses the true sine integral. Every bridge span uses a fifth-order Taylor enclosure around its exact midpoint phase, followed by integration and an explicitly bounded degree-eight truncation. The radius endpoint is not asserted to satisfy the exact bridge matching equation.
analytic_enclosure_status: Requires independent review of the supplier implementation and definition.
